canonical_data: workspace data connections, calibrated SQL examples, term libraries, chat history, and generated charts
current_repo_note: Modified GPLv3 with logo-retention and contributor terms beyond copyleft. The ChatBI scope covers this Docker-deployed product, not the DataEase BI suite.
strengths: Executes generated SQL and feeds failures back for repair
Term libraries and calibrated SQL examples that improve with use
Workspace isolation with fine-grained data permissions, plus MCP and embed integrations
weaknesses: Modified GPLv3 adds logo-retention and contributor terms beyond copyleft
Chinese-first documentation with English lagging under docs/
why_it_matters: A vendor-maintained, self-hosted ChatBI that closes the text-to-SQL loop with execution and repair rather than generation alone.
